visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A ginger cat stands on a white tiled floor looking up at the camera. A hand pours a bowl of brown liquid onto the floor, creating a splash next to the cat. (2) An elderly man with glasses and grey hair, wearing a grey sweatshirt, squats down and uses paper towels to wipe the brown mess on the white tiles. The ginger cat sits nearby on a chair, watching. (3) The man continues wiping the floor while looking frustrated. (4) The scene shifts to a man dressed as a butler in a black apron and glasses, standing next to a woman in a maid's outfit holding the ginger cat. A black and white upright floor cleaner stands between them in a modern living room with wooden floors. (5) Close-up shots of the floor cleaner's head as it moves across the tiled floor, suctioning up brown liquid, clumps of hair, and dust. The internal brush and gears are visible through a transparent cover. (6) The man in the butler apron pushes the cleaner effortlessly across a wooden floor, demonstrating its forward and backward motion. (7) The cleaner is shown lying completely flat at a 180-degree angle to clean under a low wooden shelf where the ginger cat is resting in a bed. (8) A mobile app interface is shown on screen, displaying cleaning progress at 100%, battery levels, and various cleaning mode settings like 'Standard' and 'Intense'. (9) The man is shown resting on a white sofa with the cat nearby; the cleaner sits in its charging base. (10) The cat is in a white plastic litter box, kicking grey sand onto the wooden floor outside the box. (11) The man uses the floor cleaner to suction up the scattered cat litter from the wooden floor. (12) The man lies down on the clean floor next to the ginger cat, appearing relaxed, then sits up suddenly looking surprised.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An adult male with dark hair and glasses, appearing in three roles: an elderly man in a grey sweatshirt, a butler in a white shirt and black apron with a messy wig, and a clean-shaven man in the final scene.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern apartment with a clean white-tiled kitchen, a living room with light-colored wooden flooring, and contemporary furniture including a white sofa and wooden cabinets.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp liquid splashing sound is heard, followed by a comedic 'Ah!' vocalization and high-energy electronic pop BGM. (2) A male voice with an exaggerated elderly timbre complains about a mess with high pitch variability and moderate loudness. (3) A distinct 'Ding' SFX marks a transition to a crisp, professional male narrative voice speaking quickly and clearly over a driving electronic beat. (4) Mechanical whirring and suction noises of a vacuum cleaner are layered under the narration as specific technical features are listed. (5) The sound of dry particles (cat litter) being vacuumed produces a gritty, percussive texture in the audio. (6) A cartoonish 'boing' and 'wow' SFX punctuate the demonstration of the device's flexibility. (7) The video concludes with a synthetic laughing track and a soft thud as someone lands on the floor, ending with a final comical 'Aiyo' exclamation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Problem Presentation -> Product Introduction -> Feature Demonstration -> Result/CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Roborock F25 ACE floor cleaner by using a humorous, pet-focused scenario that highlights the product's ability to clean liquid spills, hair, and cat litter effectively.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product naming, brand logo visibility, detailed feature narration, and app interface demonstration.
